result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant card in the horizontal carousel is vertically misaligned with adjacent cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card ('Smash Bros Burgers') is shifted downward compared to the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards beside it, breaking the horizontal alignment of thumbnails and text.
issues.suggestion: Remove any extra top margin or padding on the middle card and ensure all items in the horizontal scroll container share consistent top alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start).
